mechanism_claims.claim_text: Ts1 inhibition of A. nidulans was not significantly changed by tetrodotoxin, so the paper argues the antifungal activity is not explained by voltage-gated Na+ channel interaction.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Negative TTX control narrows one hypothesized mechanism but does not identify the direct fungal target.

source_locator.note: TTX control result and interpretation were checked in results/discussion and Figure 5 caption.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Calcium potentiated Ts1 growth inhibition for P. verrucosum and P. corylophilum but not for A. terreus; the paper treats this as unusual context requiring further exploration.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: Ts1 against Penicillium verrucosum, Penicillium corylophilum, and Aspergillus terreus
mechanism_claims.limitations: Calcium modulation is phenotypic context, not a resolved molecular mode of action.

source_locator.note: Calcium condition was checked from results prose and Figure 3 caption.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Ts1 reduced A. nidulans hyphal elongation without pronounced morphological alteration, supporting a non-morphogenic antifungal phenotype in the paper.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Morphology image is qualitative; no exact hyphal-length values were fabricated.
